default.description: Overlay window capability; the settings window has its own least-privilege capability in settings.json

hud.description: HUD windows (pill + canvas) and the tray panel: core:default only — they listen to the global llm:// broadcasts and invoke the custom show_hud/hide_hud/stop_chat commands; all window geometry and click-through is backend-side (hud.rs). MEM115: a window absent from every capability is denied the event ACL, so listen() would silently fail without this entry.

memory.description: Memory window: core:default only (event listen + custom-command invokes; show/hide is backend-side via memory_window.rs, settings-window posture).

settings.description: Settings window: core:default only (event listen for backend broadcasts; window show/hide is backend-side via custom IPC commands). MEM115: a window absent from every capability is denied the event ACL, so listen() silently fails while custom-command invokes still work.
